analysis: The only change in this PR is a documentation addition in docs/architecture/inference.md (head lines 1584-1592). It describes LocalTokenizerLoader resolving an absent clean_up_tokenization_spaces key to false in memory, matching Python Transformers, and keeping an explicit Boolean. The supplied units are BASE text from lines 4495-5336, which the patch does not touch. There are no code, control, config or trust-boundary changes, and I found no security regression. The documented behavior is a decode-output fidelity fix. It states that input IDs, sampling and cache keys do not depend on it, so the prefix-cache scope and HMAC lookup tags in T-041 appear unaffected. Provider-to-consumer ciphertext paths (T-008) are unchanged. The base text covers cluster, TP and batch documentation and has no modifications in this PR. Open question: the implementation in LocalTokenizerLoader.swift is not supplied. The next pass should confirm that the in-memory override cannot be influenced by an untrusted tokenizer config beyond what already exists. Also confirm that the streamed-decode byte-repeat fix does not alter the content of the E2E-encrypted output chunks. This is a docs-only claim and I treat it as unverified, not as a finding.
